title: Warmly Spiced Croatian Lamb Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic Croatian dish featuring lamb skewers with a blend of warm spices and tamarind pulp, perfect for a post-workout meal. This satvik-friendly recipe uses sous-vide cooking for tender and juicy lamb.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, tamarind pulp, paprika, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, rosemary, and bay leaves.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a single layer in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the skewers from the sous-vide machine and brush with lemon juice.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional rosemary and bay leaves if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
